results.message: When do I get paid for a Crediário sale, and is there an advance cost?
results.response:
Crediário sales are paid in one lump sum, up to 2 business days after the transaction is captured. This applies however many installments the cardholder chooses. The discount fee (MDR) is subtracted from the original transaction amount.

There is no advance cost. Getnet's Crediário page says you receive the full sale value within 2 business days with a single fee and no advance cost.

Getnet doesn't publish a specific MDR percentage on these pages. You can check your rate in the Getnet Brasil app or the Customer Portal. For anything more, call Getnet support on 4002-4000.

results.message: When do I get paid for a Crediário sale, and is there an advance cost?
results.response:
Getnet's Crediário page gives these details:

- **When you get paid:** Crediário sales are paid in up to 2 business days after the transaction is captured. You get the full amount in one payment, however many installments the cardholder picks. The discount fee is subtracted from the original transaction value.
- **Advance cost:** Getnet says you receive the sale value in up to 2 business days with a single fee and no advance (anticipation) cost.

The pages I found don't state the percentage of the single fee. You can check whether Crediário is enabled and see your rates in the Getnet app under Meu negócio > Taxas e modalidades > Cartões, or in the Portal do Cliente. You can also call Getnet support on 4002-4000.

results.message: Como habilito a antecipação automática pelo aplicativo e quanto tempo leva?
results.response:
Para habilitar a antecipação automática no app Getnet Brasil, siga estes passos:

1. Acesse o app com seu login e senha.
2. Clique no menu **Serviços**.
3. Selecione **Antecipação Automática**.
4. Clique em **Habilitar**.
5. Insira sua senha, leia os termos e condições e clique em **Habilitar**.
6. Sua solicitação é enviada.

**Prazo:** a solicitação pode demorar até 48 horas.

Para ativar ou desativar, é preciso ter perfil administrativo e senha. A habilitação é livre. Para a antecipação ocorrer de fato, é preciso ter pelo menos R$ 50,00 de saldo.

Os resultados da busca não informam em quanto tempo o valor antecipado é creditado. Para saber esse prazo, ligue para a central da Getnet: 4002-4000.

results.message: Do I need to buy a SIM card or a data plan for my card machine?
results.response:
No, you don't need to buy a SIM card or a data plan. Getnet's help page says the machine already comes with an exclusive chip and its own data plan for your sales.

You can also connect the machine to Wi-Fi. Wi-Fi is more stable than mobile networks, and it avoids using the machine's data plan.

I found nothing on Getnet's website about which models use Ethernet, or about connectivity differences between models. For that, you can call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

results.message: Do I need to buy a SIM card or a data plan for my card machine?
results.response:
No. According to Getnet's help page, the card machine already comes with an exclusive SIM chip and its own data plan for your sales. You don't have to buy a SIM card or a plan.

The pages I found don't say whether this differs by model. They also don't mention Ethernet.

You can connect the machine to Wi-Fi as well. Getnet says Wi-Fi avoids using the machine's data plan. It also says Wi-Fi is more stable than mobile networks. For details on models or Ethernet, call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

results.message: O que é o erro ADQ 1-87 e como resolver?
results.response:

6. Selecione a Função 90. A tela ficará verde novamente.

results.message: How do I cancel a card sale in the Minha Conta portal?
results.response:
To cancel a card sale in the Minha Conta portal, follow these steps:

1. Log in to the Minha Conta portal.
2. In the left-hand menu, click **Vendas**.
3. Click the **Cartão** modality.
4. In the period filter, select the date the sale was made.
5. Find the sale you want to cancel.
6. Click the **[+]** icon next to the status column.
7. Click **Cancelar venda**.
8. Request the cancellation.

**Limitation:** Cancellation is only available for sales in the **Cartão** modality. For **Voucher** sales, you have to contact the card brand directly.

After the request, a fully cancelled sale shows as "Cancelada" in the Histórico de Vendas statement. A partly cancelled sale shows as "Cancelada Parcial". You can check the result under **Pedidos e atendimentos > Atendimentos**.

The pages I found don't state any deadline for cancelling. For that, you can call Getnet support on 4002-4000.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-gestao-de-vendas/como-cancelar-minhas-vendas/ and https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-gestao-de-vendas/onde-consultar-uma-venda-cancelada/

O modo quiosque é gerenciado pelo aplicativo "Configurar" da Get Smart.

results.message: How do I install an app on my Get Smart after I receive it?
results.response:
To install an app on your Get Smart after you receive it, use the Getstore app:

1. Open the Getstore app on the terminal.
2. Select the "Todos os Aplicativos" (All Apps) tab.
3. Choose the app and install it. You'll need to confirm access with your Portal Minha Conta username and password.

You can also choose the automation you want on Getnet's website or through the Getstore on the Get Smart.

The system apps Pagamento, Getstore and Configurar come already installed. They can't be removed or hidden.

results.message: Como vendo com Pix por aproximação pelo Get Tap?
results.response:
**O que é:** o Get Tap transforma seu smartphone em maquininha. Com ele, você aceita pagamentos por aproximação, sem aluguel nem mensalidade. O Pix é mais uma opção de pagamento, somada ao crédito e ao débito. O cliente paga com o app do próprio banco ou com a carteira digital dele. A confirmação do Pix é em tempo real.

**Requisitos para ativar:**
- O Get Tap funciona em aparelhos Android 11 ou superior com NFC. Podem usá-lo pessoas físicas e MEIs que atendam aos requisitos mínimos de segurança.
- Você precisa habilitar a função e vincular uma conta bancária pelo app Getnet Brasil.

**Como habilitar:**
1. Abra o app Getnet Brasil e faça login.
2. Vá em "Serviços" e toque em "Venda com Pix".
3. Clique em "Habilitar".
4. Escolha o banco e siga as instruções na tela para vincular a conta que receberá os pagamentos.

**Como vender:**
1. No app Getnet Brasil, faça login.
2. Na tela inicial, toque em "Vender" e escolha "Get Tap - Aproximação".
3. Digite o valor.
4. Escolha o Pix, por QR Code ou por aproximação.
5. Na aproximação, o cliente encosta o celular ou relógio com a carteira digital atrás do seu smartphone.
6. Finalize e aguarde a confirmação de "venda aprovada". Se precisar, compartilhe o comprovante.

O cliente pode escolher entre QR Code e aproximação, porque a aproximação não é obrigatória.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-get-tap/como-habilitar-e-vender-com-pix-no-get-tap/

results.message: Como vendo com Pix por aproximação pelo Get Tap?
results.response:
**O que é:** o Get Tap transforma seu smartphone em maquininha. O Pix por aproximação é uma das formas de receber por ele. O cliente pode pagar por QR Code ou por aproximação, e nenhuma das duas é obrigatória. O Pix soma-se ao crédito e ao débito e não os substitui. O cliente paga pelo app do próprio banco ou pela carteira digital, e a confirmação é em tempo real.

**Requisitos:**
- Ter o Get Tap instalado.
- Habilitar a função de venda com Pix e vincular uma conta bancária no app Getnet Brasil.
- O Get Tap está disponível para Android 11 ou superior com NFC.
- Podem usar o Get Tap pessoas físicas e MEIs que atendam aos requisitos mínimos de segurança.

**Como habilitar:**
1. No app Getnet Brasil, faça login.
2. Vá em "Serviços" e toque em "Venda com Pix".
3. Clique em "Habilitar".
4. Escolha o banco e siga as instruções na tela para vincular a conta que receberá os pagamentos.

**Como vender:**
1. Abra o app Getnet Brasil e faça login.
2. Em "Vender", escolha "Get Tap - Aproximação".
3. Digite o valor.
4. Escolha Pix por aproximação (ou por QR Code).
5. Peça ao cliente para aproximar o celular ou relógio com a carteira digital atrás do seu smartphone.
6. Aguarde a confirmação de "venda aprovada". Se precisar, compartilhe o comprovante.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-get-tap/como-habilitar-e-vender-com-pix-no-get-tap/

results.message: How much does the starter Payment Link plan cost?
results.response:
I found no Payment Link plan called "starter" on Getnet's website. These are the Payment Link figures it does publish:

- **Monthly price:** Link de Pagamento is listed at R$ 14,90/mês.
- **Fee:** The Link Get Pay simulator on the Payment Link page shows a single rate of 1,90%. This is a simulator figure, and the page says rates may change depending on the products and services you contract.
- **Eligibility:** The condition is valid only for individuals, MEIs, companies with annual revenue up to R$ 3 million, and new customers. It is subject to credit analysis.

For exact terms for your business, call Getnet support on 4002-4000.

- **GS-48213 (Get Smart):** está offline e foi vista pela última vez há 19 horas. Ela usa Wi-Fi, o último erro foi E-NET-02 (sem conexão de rede) e o firmware 3.8.1 **não está atualizado**.

Não consigo ver nos dados da conta se o Pix por aproximação está ativado ou disponível em alguma delas, nem o motivo de a opção não aparecer.

Não encontrei quais modelos aceitam Pix por aproximação, nem requisitos de firmware ou de internet. Para isso, ligue para o **4002-4000**.

O Get Tap, que transforma o celular em maquininha, é um produto diferente. Com ele instalado e o Pix habilitado, o cliente pode pagar por QR Code ou por aproximação.

results.message: One of my terminals is offline with an error. What is the error and how do I fix it?
results.response:
The offline terminal is **GC-30977** (Get Clássica, GPRS connection). It shows error **ADQ 1-87**, a chip registration error. It was last seen 72 hours ago, though the exact start time of the error isn't available. Its firmware is 5.0.2, which is not up to date. Your other terminal, GC-30418, is online with no errors.

**How to fix it (from Getnet's help page):**
1. Confirm the chip is properly inserted in the terminal.
2. Press the Function key.
3. Enter 25. The screen turns green to confirm.
4. Enter the Merchant Password (Senha do Lojista).
5. Select Function 46. The screen turns green.
6. Select Function 90. The screen turns green again.
7. Make a test sale.

The help page says nothing specific to the Get Clássica model, the GPRS connection or the firmware version. If the error continues, call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-87/

results.message: One of my terminals is offline with an error. What is the error and how do I fix it?
results.response:
The offline terminal is GC-30977 (Get Clássica). It shows error ADQ 1-87, a chip registration error. It was last seen 72 hours ago and connects via GPRS. Its firmware is 5.0.2, which is not up to date. Your other terminal, GC-30418, is online with no errors.

**How to fix it:**
1. Confirm the chip is properly inserted in the terminal.
2. Press the Function key.
3. Enter 25. The screen turns green to confirm.
4. Enter the Merchant Password (Senha do Lojista).
5. Select Function 46. The screen turns green.
6. Select Function 90. The screen turns green again.
7. Make a test sale.

Getnet's help page doesn't mention firmware updates or the terminal being offline. If the steps don't work, call Getnet support on 4002-4000.

results.message: My R$ 612 credit sale was declined today. Why? And how do I cancel a card sale in the portal if I ever need to?
results.response:
**Why your R$ 612 sale was declined**
- Transaction TX-71225 (credit, R$ 612.00) was declined today, 2026-11-26, on machine GC-30418.
- Decline code: 05, "Do not honor, declined by the card issuer".
- The data doesn't show the time of the transaction.
- I couldn't find an explanation of code 05 or what you can do about it. For that, please call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

**How to cancel a card sale in the portal**

Cancelling is only available for sales made as **Card**. For Voucher sales, you have to contact the card brand directly.

1. Log in to the Minha Conta portal.
2. In the left menu, click **Vendas**.
3. Click the **Cartão** type.
4. In the period filter, select the date of the sale.
5. Find the sale you want to cancel.
6. Click the **[+]** icon next to the status column.
7. Click **"Cancelar venda"**.
8. Submit the cancellation request.

To check the result, go to **Pedidos e atendimentos > Atendimentos** and click "mostrar" on the sale. Cancelled sales show in the sales history as "Cancelada" (full) or "Cancelada Parcial" (partial).

**Deadlines**
- A reversal requested through the Getnet Brasil app can be made up to 90 days after the transaction, and it is processed within 2 business days.
- Reversing directly on the card machine only works for sales made the same day.

results.message: My R$ 612 credit sale was declined today. Why? And how do I cancel a card sale in the portal if I ever need to?
results.response:
**Why your sale was declined:** Your R$ 612.00 credit sale today (2026-11-26) on terminal GC-30418 (transaction ID TX-71225) was declined with code 05, "Do not honor, declined by the card issuer." No other details are shown for this decline.

**How to cancel a card sale in the Portal Minha Conta:**
1. Log in to the Portal Minha Conta.
2. In the left-hand menu, click **Vendas**.
3. Click the **Cartão** modality.
4. In the period filter, select the date the sale was made.
5. Find the sale you want to cancel.
6. Click the **[+]** icon next to the status column.
7. Click **"Cancelar venda"** and submit the cancellation request.

**Conditions:**
- Cancellation is only available for the **Cartão** modality. For Voucher sales, you have to contact the card network (bandeira) directly.
- A sale cancelled on the same day is shown as "Estornada". A full cancellation on a different day is shown as "Cancelada".
- The pages I found don't state a deadline for cancelling. For that, you can call Getnet support on 4002-4000.

You can check the result of a request under **Pedidos e atendimentos > Atendimentos** in the portal.

results.message: Which of my machines needs attention, and how do I install a new app on the Get Smart ones?
results.response:
One of your three machines needs attention:

- **GM-40555 (Get Mini):** it is offline and was last seen 5 hours ago. It connects by Bluetooth. Its last error is E-BAT-01 (battery critically low), and its firmware is 2.3.1, which is not up to date.

Your two Get Smart machines, **GS-60021** and **GS-60022**, are working normally. Both are online on wifi, have no errors, and run firmware 3.9.0 (up to date).

**Installing a new app on a Get Smart**
1. Open the Getstore on the Get Smart.
2. Select the "Todos os Aplicativos" (All Apps) tab.
3. Choose the app and install it. You confirm access with your Portal Minha Conta username and password.

Apps are downloaded from the Getstore. You can also choose an automation on Getnet's website instead of browsing the Getstore on the terminal. The system apps Pagamento, Getstore and Configurar come pre-installed, and they can't be removed or hidden.

results.message: Is my Get Mini working, and does it need its own SIM card or data plan?
results.response:
Yes, your Get Mini (serial GM-10377) is working. It's online and connected by Bluetooth, it was last seen just now, and it has no reported errors. Its firmware is 2.4.0, which is up to date.

You don't need to buy a SIM card or a data plan. Getnet card machines come with an exclusive chip and their own data plan for your sales. The machine works on its own using GPRS technology, and you don't need an app to make sales. You can also connect it to Wi-Fi, which avoids using the machine's data plan.

Getnet's help pages don't say anything about the Get Mini connecting to the internet by Bluetooth pairing with a smartphone. If you want to confirm that, you can call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

That information covers Getnet card machines in general and doesn't name the Get Mini specifically. For model-specific confirmation, you can call Getnet support on 4002-4000.

results.message: Can I cancel a voucher sale the same way?
results.response:
No. Getnet's page says cancelling sales is only available for transactions in the Cartão modality. To cancel a sale in the Voucher modality, contact the card brand directly.

The pages I found don't describe any other procedure for Voucher sales. For more help, you can call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-gestao-de-vendas/como-cancelar-minhas-vendas/

evidence.output:
merchant: How do I cancel a card sale in the Minha Conta portal?
assistant: To cancel a card sale in the Minha Conta portal:

1. Log in to the Portal Minha Conta.
2. In the left-hand menu, click **Vendas**.
3. Click the **Cartão** modality.
4. In the period filter, select the date the sale was made.
5. Find the sale you want to cancel.
6. Click the **[+]** icon next to the status column.
7. Click **"Cancelar venda"**, then submit the cancellation request.

**Conditions:**
- Cancellation is only available for transactions in the **Cartão** modality. To cancel a Voucher sale, contact the card brand directly.
- Cancelled sales show in the Histórico de Vendas statement as "Cancelada" for a full cancellation, or "Cancelada Parcial" when only part of the amount is cancelled.
- To check the result of a request, go to **Pedidos e atendimentos** > **Atendimentos**. Find the sale and click "mostrar".

The pages I found don't state any deadlines or value limits for cancellations. For those, you can call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-gestao-de-vendas/como-cancelar-minhas-vendas/

evidence.output:
merchant: How do I cancel a card sale in the Minha Conta portal?
assistant: To cancel a card sale in the Minha Conta portal:

1. Log in to the Minha Conta portal with your username and password.
2. In the left-hand menu, click **Vendas**.
3. Click the **Cartão** modality.
4. In the period filter, select the date the sale was made.
5. Find the sale you want to cancel.
6. Click the [+] icon next to the status column.

results.message: What do I have to send, and by when?
results.response:
Your human agent said to send the signed receipt through the app within 7 days. That is the instruction for your case (protocol CB-20931).

Getnet's chargeback help page describes the general process differently:
- It says to send the documentation with the evidence, in a single file, within 12 calendar days of the notification date.
- It also says you can't add or complete documents after they are sent to the issuer, so send everything at once.
- What to include depends on the reason for the dispute. For fraud, the documents must show that the cardholder is the buyer or that the two are linked. For a "did not receive" claim, you must prove delivery, for example with an invoice, shipping proof, tracking code or delivery confirmation.

The page doesn't explain the difference between 7 and 12 days. To confirm the deadline for your case, call Getnet support at 4002-4000 or ask your agent on ticket TCK-E96A44C5.
